# External sources for persona clustering

Place raw downloads under this folder. Large files may be gitignored.

| Folder | Source | Licence | Fetch |
|--------|--------|---------|-------|
| `jobcannon/` | [JobCannon Psychometric Response Dataset](https://github.com/PeterKolomiets/jobcannon-psychometric-dataset) | CC-BY-4.0 | `scripts/08_1_fetch_external_clustering_data.py` |
| `onet/` | [O*NET Database](https://www.onetcenter.org/database.html) Interests + Occupation Data | US DOL / see O*NET terms (Interest Profiler CC-BY) | same script (best-effort) |

Optional (manual deposit):

| Dataset | Link | Notes |
|---------|------|-------|
| Vietnamese secondary career counseling | https://doi.org/10.17632/kh5c4m3gpk | Youth + short Holland; map fields before use |
| SMIT Engineering Career Aspirations | https://doi.org/10.17632/4chz76p5yx | Engineering-skewed RIASEC |

See also [docs/curated_leavers.md](../../docs/curated_leavers.md) and root [DATA.md](../../DATA.md).
